 Home News Local News Lincoln Land To Host FAFSA Completion Event Lincoln Land To Host FAFSA Completion Event
 Wed, October 21, 2026 by Dalton Ewer 
 SHARE NOW 
 Lincoln Land Community College (LLCC) is set to host a Free Application for Federal Student Aid (FAFSA) completion event on Nov. 4.
 Director of LLCC, Elizabeth Fines Workman, was a guest on the WTIM Morning Show, and said that FAFSA is meant to be an easy process, but there is still a lot to get done and to fill out during the application process. The event is meant to assist students and parents in filling out the FAFSA and will take place on the LLCC Taylorville campus.
 https://tdn-435957167126-us-east-2-an.s3.us-east-2.amazonaws.com/2026/10/WORKMAN-1-.mp3 
 Workman also explained that LLCC financial aid professionals will provide personalized help for students and their parents during the event, which will take place from 4 to 6:30 PM at the LLCC Campus in Taylorville
 https://tdn-435957167126-us-east-2-an.s3.us-east-2.amazonaws.com/2026/10/WORKMAN-2.mp3 
 Registration is not required, and families can make a 30-minute appointment at a time that is convenient for them.
 LLCC Financial Aid on the main campus in Springfield will offer drop-in or appointment FAFSA assistance from Monday through Friday from 8 AM to 4:30 PM.
 To contact, call or text 217-786-2237 or email [email protected] .
 The LLCC Taylorville Campus can be found at 800 South Spresser Street, which is near the Taylorville Municipal Airport.
